en.headline: Precision at the bottom of the dial.
en.summary: Finer scroll strength, true zero-duration movement, safer settings, and the first formal Windows installer.
new: Single-scroll strength now reaches 10 instead of stopping at 30.
Animation duration now supports 0 ms for immediate configured movement.
A formal per-user Windows installer now supports upgrades and uninstall.
improved: Low positive durations stay exactly where the user sets them.
Settings are written through a same-directory temporary file before replacement.
Existing settings remain in place during install, upgrade, and uninstall.
fixed: Old animation tails are cancelled when switching to 0 ms or changing direction.
Horizontal, reverse, and consecutive immediate scrolling keep the correct amount.

zh.headline: 把精细控制带到刻度最底端。
zh.summary: 更低的滚动强度、真正的 0ms 即时滚动、更安全的设置保存，以及首个正式 Windows 安装包。
new: 单次滚动强度最低值由 30 调整为 10。
动画时长支持 0ms，立即发送当前配置的滚动量。
新增正式的当前用户 Windows 安装包，支持升级和卸载。
improved: 较低的正动画时长会严格保留用户设置。
设置文件先写入同目录临时文件，再安全覆盖。
安装、升级和卸载过程中保留原有用户设置。
fixed: 切换到 0ms 或改变方向时会取消旧动画尾巴。
修复水平、反向和连续即时滚动的步进量。

en.headline: The first public glide.
en.summary: The initial public beta introduced system-wide smoothing, profiles, app exclusions, tray controls, and bilingual themes.
new: System-wide smooth mouse wheel scrolling for Windows 10/11.
Quick, medium, native, and custom tuning profiles.
Per-app exclusions, tray controls, and Chinese/English UI.

zh.headline: 第一次公开的丝滑滚动。
zh.summary: 首个公开测试版带来了全局平滑滚动、手感方案、应用排除、托盘控制和双语主题。
new: 支持 Windows 10/11 的全局鼠标滚轮平滑处理。
提供快速、中速、原生与自定义手感方案。
支持应用排除、托盘控制和中英文界面。
